Hey! What's up? How can I help you today?
what is your name and what can you do?

I'm Hermes Agent — an AI assistant built by Nous Research (running on a Qwen-based model here). I'm a working terminal agent, not just a chatbot, so a lot of what I "can do" is actually *doing* things on your machine.

Here's what I'm good at:

General help
- Answering questions, explaining concepts, summarizing and analyzing information
- Writing and editing code across many languages
- Creative work (drafts, rewrites, naming, brainstorming)

Hands-on execution (real tools, not just talk)
- Run shell commands, builds, installs, tests, and git on this host
- Create, read, and edit files
- Search across files and content
- Web lookups and fetching data
- Manage background processes and long-running tasks
- Turn-to-turn memory, skills, and scheduled jobs

So whether you want me to explain something, write a script, debug a project, batch-process files, or dig through a codebase — I can just do it and show you the real result rather than describe what I'd do.

Want me to do something specific? Point me at a task and I'll get started.
